CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization present.

COD.rationale: Content (color assignments) and organization (explicit coordinate lists) are present and origins/status metadata distinguish record kinds for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to content organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content items identify grid coordinates with colour attributes (red/blue).

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata (kinds like copied_prior_record, history_estimate) are attributed separately from the coordinate content.

O.rationale: Explicit statements of how content is presented/organized via coordinate sets and labeled current/candidate records.
